title: Dollar Drops to R$ 5.17
subtitle: The dollar showed a significant decline in September, influencing the financial market
excerpt: Dollar drops to R$ 5.17, with a 0.15% decline in September
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The dollar dropped to R$ 5.17, presenting a decline of 0.15% in September. This variation reflects the constant fluctuations in the financial market.

The dollar fell around 1% on a day of global relief in the financial market, ending September with a slight decline. This demonstrates the volatility of the exchange market.

The stock exchange also showed a positive performance, advancing almost 1.5% in trading and accumulating a gain of just over 5% for the month. These movements indicate the complexity and interconnection of financial markets.

With information from Agência Brasil.
